title: When the Escarpment Wakes
author: Lior Iversen
blurb: Ivo Zhou, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must cross the range ahead of the snows before the concession permits expire.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
